reviewed_points: For at least nine heavy residues, a missing-direction set cannot contain a complete binary plane; any three distinct missing directions are therefore independent.
Light2/light3 fibres contribute at most one/two incidences over the independent missing triple.
Pairs in k independent directions form disjoint k-cubes on2^(5-k) cosets; local maxima and exact occupancy convolution therefore give the stated E_k(w).
Each selected heavy-light edge uses a distinct endpoint-direction incidence, bounded by E_k for its actual set of k directions.
With u active light-light edges, the identity adding lambda*(sum k+2u) leaves (1-2lambda)*u<=0 when lambda>=1/2; thus the displayed price upper bound is valid.
The example support17 profile has B9, price4, heavy excesses9 and1, and upper bound46<48.
Ring carries translate quotient sumsets and do not alter the cardinality inequalities.
scope: Analytic proof review only; no claim of full proof-assistant formalization or human refereeing.
